notes.title: Ver1.10 Sale items were added. Season MP and event items can be acquired even i
notes.content:
Thank you for playing.
We have updated the following items.
Sale items have been added
1, Beginner's Pack
15 rare items, 3 each of Special Weapon, Armor, and Special Slot, so you can get 3 custom equipment right away!
2、Gasha Ticket Pack
10 rare tickets and 10 UR tickets each, with skins!
3、Enhancement Ticket Pack
10 each of Enhancement Ticket and Limit Breakthrough Ticket, with skins!

Season MP and 30 battles item get campaign can now be achieved even in CPU battles.
Added a button to remove equipment.
Equipment balance has been adjusted.
The UI has been enlarged to make it a little easier to see.

We look forward to your continued support of Retsubato.

notes.title: Implementation of CPU battles in multi-battles! Balance adjustment of many equip
notes.content:
Thank you for playing!
We have updated the following contents.

CPU battles in multi-battles have been implemented.
You can fight against CPU in multi-battle. There are two types of modes: one in which allies are CPUs, and the other in which players are allies (there are Random Match and Aikouji Match).
In the mode where the CPU is your ally, you can choose between "close range type," "long range type," and "support type" allies.
The difficulty level is challenging from about stage 30, so please play with your friends and carefully select your equipment!


Training mode has been implemented.
This is a mode in which the opponent does not attack. Use it to check your equipment.
PC version only,
Y:Dash
U:Special 1
I: Special 2
O:Weapon1
P:Weapon2
P:Weapon2

Equipment modification and special ability addition
1. added special abilities
Blind: Hit rate is greatly reduced by one-third.
Slip: Increased susceptibility to being blown up.
All Cure: Heal all abnormalities only once.
2. equipment modifications.
We have slightly weakened some equipment that was too strong and strengthened some equipment that was not used.
Added special abilities to most unused equipment to make it more unique.
Some specials are now treated as melee attacks and cannot be blocked by barriers. (Special ability: melee has been added).

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: ver1.01 bug fix update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing.

Fixed a bug that caused the player's position and camera to spawn in the correct place.
